hypothesis: When a completed session boundary is crossed by broad spot-and-perpetual initiative and the immediately following completed minute preserves outside price, same-direction spot/perpetual flow, and same-direction L1 pressure without spread deterioration, a new liquidity-vacuum auction leg has begun. Enter that leg immediately rather than waiting for two outside closes and a late retest.

role_separation.transition_confirmation: first strictly later completed minute preserves outside price, spot/perpetual direction, and L1 pressure
role_separation.entry: confirmation close through NautilusTrader market order
role_separation.invalidation: completed source boundary reacceptance with structural buffer
role_separation.objective: nearest unconsumed completed-session liquidity in the new leg
role_separation.unresolved: no immediate persistence or no costed same-leg objective
